json_explanations.UF:
Usefulness
Calculates this player's contribution to their team, scaled by Elo and songs played
json_explanations.Score:
Calculates this player's value (Usefulness) against what's expected from their Elo
50 means this player is playing to expectations
json_explanations.Mean Over-8: Average of correct guessers across songs this player/team guessed correctly
json_explanations.Lives Taken:
Count of points won against the opposing team
Correct guessers exclusively on their team
json_explanations.Lives Saved:
Count of blocks achieved against the opposing team
Lone correct guesser for their team whilst the opposing team also has correct guesser(s)
json_explanations.Solo Rigs: Count of songs exclusively from this player's list
json_explanations.Rig Over-8: Average of correct guessers across songs from this player's list
json_explanations.Over-8 Δ:
Rig Over-8 - Mean Over-8
Calculates the difficulty gap between this player's list and correct guesses
json_explanations.Rig Δ:
100 * (Correct - Rig) / Correct
Calculates this player's performance against their own list
json_explanations.Median Time: Median guess time across songs this player guessed correctly
json_explanations.Total 4-0s: Count of songs where all players from one team guessed correctly and all players from the other team missed
json_explanations.Rig Synergy: Average team guess rate across songs from its own members' lists
json_explanations.Off Synergy: Average team guess rate across songs from the opposing team member's lists
json_explanations.Shared Rigs: Calculates how much songs are shared across its own members' lists
json_explanations.Contribution Rate:
100 * (Lives Taken + Saved) / Correct
Calculates how much of this player's correct guesses directly contributed to the scoreline
json_explanations.Best Solo Rig Converter:
100 * Solo from Solo Rig / Solo Rig
Shows the best player at converting their own solo rig into a solo
json_explanations.Worst Solo Rig Converter:
100 * Solo from Solo Rig / Solo Rig
Shows the worst player at converting their own solo rig into a solo
